name: rectangular_block_front_hole_top_boss
description: A rectangular block with a circular through hole on the front face and a raised rectangular boss on the top face.
source_license: Project-authored example; not from an external dataset.
derived_by: Hand-authored from validated Prompt2ParametricCAD eval JSON.
construction_plan: Create a rectangular base block with enough thickness for side-face features.
Cut the circular hole from base.front using side-face coordinates.
Use a second-coordinate value near 0 on side faces so the feature stays centered vertically.
Add the rectangular boss on base.top using normal top-view XY coordinates.
notes: Side-face positions are not the same as top-view positions.
For side faces, the second coordinate is vertical height relative to the center of that face.
